description: Mint the agent an on-chain identity in the Metaplex Agent Registry on Solana, carrying its EIP-8004 registration document, an x402Support flag, and on-chain attributes naming its payment address, its vault, and the token it accepts. After this the agent is discoverable on metaplex.com/agents and any counterparty can read where to pay it. Costs about 0.007 SOL and needs an owner signing key (set OWNER_SECRET_KEY or pass `secret`); to mint from Phantom or a Ledger instead, use prepare_agent_mint in @three-ws/metaplex-agent-mcp. Requires confirm:true to broadcast.

model_url.description: GLB avatar URL, rendered on metaplex.com/agents.

name.description: On-chain name. Defaults to the agent label or id.

secret.description: Owner secret key for this call only.

services.description: Endpoints this agent serves, e.g. its own x402 API.

name: deploy_agent_onchain
title: Publish the agent on-chain with its payment address
